Elon Musk's AI image generator, a pond, and 30 seconds of nonstop output
caption:
This is Grok Imagine, xAI's AI image generator, given a single pond scene and 30 seconds to run. No prompt editing, no mid-session steering.

The speed is the point. Generating images that look like this used to take a designer and hours of work with the right software. An AI image model now does it in seconds. Most people still have no idea how fast this gap closed.
